natural_language_statement:
The finite set of residues modulo $m$ that are units has exactly $\varphi(m)$ elements.

This is the bridge between the two ways of writing the density hypothesis of the main theorem. One side counts a `Finset (ZMod m)` and the other is `Nat.totient m`. Mathlib proves the group-theoretic form, that the unit group $(\mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z})^\times$ has $\varphi(m)$ elements; what is wanted here is the same count for the `Finset` of unit residues that the other statements sum over.
source: Xuancheng Shao, "A density version of the Vinogradov three primes theorem", Duke Math. J. 163 (2014) 489-512, arXiv:1206.6139v2, https://arxiv.org/abs/1206.6139, used throughout Sections 1 and 3
